C0752.title: Micron Case and China's Cybersecurity Review Regime
C0752.summary: On March 31, 2023, the Cyberspace Administration of China announced a cybersecurity review of Micron products sold in China to safeguard critical information infrastructure supply-chain security and prevent product issues or hidden risks from causing cybersecurity risks. The case shows that critical information infrastructure operators need to consider supply-chain security, review requirements, and critical infrastructure protection compliance when procuring network products and services.

references.title: Announcement on Initiating a Cybersecurity Review of Micron Products Sold in China
